distinguishing: Esther Adler (née Shatski), from Ostrog, White Russia; Paris-based actress of the WWI era onward, wife of actor Yaakov Piekarnik. Murdered in the Holocaust (deported 1942 via Chalon/Drancy). Western-European (London/Paris/Belgium) milieu, not the American Adler dynasty.
